rules.text: The closeout criteria = `req_all_done()` (including successors of split/merged being all done) + 0 pending proposals + 0 running jobs + 0 conflicts.

The summary travels through the kernel's structured receipt channel `ygg.meta("summary", {…})` and lands in the receipt envelope at `meta.summary` (stage / ending / verifyPassed / nextEndsRun / pendingProposals / requirementCount / conflicts / awaiting / evolution{artifact,summary,candidates,classes}); the host only reads that field, so writing the same content into the narrative cannot be misread; a payload of "0" is read-only.
The host never reads a Mod's private KV: with a Mod that has no `agent.summary`, the host reports "unknown" and pauses safely instead of falling back to `ending` / `fsm.stage` / `prop.*` / `req.*`.
`meta` is a transient receipt surface: it never enters the save, the canonical snapshot or the state hash — the same event sequence yields the same `state_hash` whether or not `ygg.meta` is called.

Direct mutation actions of the main agent: requirement.split "parent|child title A|child title B[|…]" (the parent becomes split, children inherit the deps, at least 2 children); requirement.merge "source_id_1,source_id_2|merged title|merged description" (sources become merged, the new requirement unions their deps); requirement.amend "id|new title|new description|new deps" (rev+1; amending a done requirement derives a new one, amending a developing one only updates its notes); requirement.conflict "id1,id2|note" (both become blocked; dispatch and closing skip them); requirement.resolve "id1,id2|keep_both|keep_first|revise[|note]".

Lane ledger: `lane.pool "label|path"` registers a named pool (idempotent upsert; label `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,23}$`, reserved seq/pools; path = the local checkout passed to the host as `--repo`). `lane.claim "lane|req_id|branch|base|clean|label"` claims or backfills a lane (clean must be "1"; a dirty tree may not be claimed; the trailing pool segment is optional — omitted = the default pool of the run repo). `lane.release "lane|label"` releases it (idempotent, (pool, lane)-scoped). Parallelism counts per pool (each pool k ∈ 1..job_capacity); the conflict radar compares probes within one pool only.

config.open / config.close enter and leave the second-level config sub-page (play mode · evolution preference · gates); it is a presentation layer only and never advances state. config.set / guide.show / map.show are always-on read-only / configuration actions. Pre-registration keys that do not take a menu item go through a direct `config.set`: review.evolution.artifact / summary / candidates / classes (stored in `settings.review.evolution.*`, shape-checked per key; `settlement.evolution` validates them together and writes this round's registration, and `review.note` then archives it single-source into `review.evolution.*`), goal.authorization (the run-level goal authorization used by the closing check), executor.<rN>.<stage> (the executor ledger; not checked at closing, display only).
